NSUI Protestors Demand Resignation of Gyanesh Kumar, Detained by Police

Members of the NSUI (National Students' Union of India) protested in Delhi, demanding the resignation of Gyanesh Kumar. During the protest, police detained NSUI workers. Reports indicate protestors chanted slogans such as 'Gyanesh Kumar, resign now' and that protestors 'ran Delhi Police'.
